language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hi, I am Aaylah! I live next to Turtle Beach on the Cayman Islands. This is my house with all these beautiful flowers and trees.
In school we are learning all about plants. My teacher told us we will learn to “classify” plants. Do you know what that means?
It means that we will learn to group plants. For example as flowering plants or as non-flowering plants. Or, group plants as seed plants or non-seed plants.

My mama picked the lily from our garden so that I could wear it. My lily is a seed plant. Can you help me classify the flowers and trees that surround my home? Perhaps I can pick a flower for you, too!
Aaylah, I think we would all like to learn about classifying plants. Let's do it!

exercises.title: Seed Plants vs. Spore Bearing Plants

dialog.text: Did you know that seeds produce flowering plants and spores produce non-flowering plants? I will point to a plant. Can you tell me if it is a flowering seed plant or spore bearing plant?

helperSimple.text: Aaylah is pointing to a plant. Is it a seed or spore bearing plant?

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: The hibiscus is a big flower that can bloom as large as a child's head. They need lots of water! The Hibiscus is a spore bearing plant.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: Poppy plants are very popular in gardens. They grow fast and many gardeners find them attractive. The Poppy plants are flowering seed plants.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: Ferns live in moist and shaded areas for up to 2 years. They do not have seeds or flowers. The Fern is a spore bearing plant.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: Algae do not have leaves, stems or roots. They thrive in a wet environment. The Algae are spore plants.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: Moss reproduces by developing small bumpy cases on its leaves or stems. The Moss is a spore bearing plant.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: Orchids are the most complex of all flowers. They attract insects and have a lip where insects can land. The Orchids are seed plants.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: The large center of the Sunflower is made up of many tiny flowers. The Sunflower is a flowering seed plant.

outro.text: Thank you! That was a big help.
